finding.text: The daily owner card now adds `unworked` to its flagged total (Servex/TaskLoop.js:145). A run in the worktree counts 272 unworked against 28 other flags, so the card would say "about 300 rows fell through today" and the day's real misses get lost in it. Simpler: keep `unworked` out of the `flagged` sum and give it its own clause in the card text, e.g. "28 flagged · 272 open tasks untouched over 7 days".

The two docs give different numbers. The queue readme (public/framework/ai/queue/readme.md:22) and FollowUp's HEAD (Server/FollowUp.mjs:158) say "133 stale tasks". The new count finds 272, because it also counts `idle` and `waiting` tasks, not only the queue. Say what the 133 measured, or drop the number. The HEAD line also writes "7 days" as text where the page uses `UNWORKED_D`.
There was no requirements.md in the task folder. I reviewed against the brief in page.jsonl (agent-base items 6 and 7). No page changed, so this covers only Requirements and Words.
